Name: Better Quality Increased Seeds - Stephan's Crops for PFM
Author: metalax
Description:
Uses the Producer Framework Mod to increase the number of seeds produced by the seed maker when higher quality produce are used.

One additional seed is given for each quality level.

Regular: 1 - 3
Silver: 2 - 4
Gold: 3 - 5
Iridium: 4 - 6

This mod covers all produce from the 'Stephan's Lots of Crops' mod that can be processed by the seed maker.

[size=4]Installation:[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Install [url=https://www.smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970]Producer Framework Mod[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720]Json Assets[/url]
[*] Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3171]Stephan's Lots of Crops[/url]
[*] Unzip the download and move the [code][PFM] Better Quality Increase Seeds Stephan's Crops[/code] folder into [code]../Stardew Valley/Mods[/code].
[*] Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

If you are also using PPJA - Fruits and Veggies, make sure you are using the compatibility version of 'Stephan's Lots of Crops' and use the 'Better Quality Increase Seeds Stephan's Wild Crops' from the file section here.

[size=4]Compatibility[/size]
[list=1]
[*] Created with Stardew Valley 1.4 on Windows. Should be fine on Linux/Mac.
[*] Due to PFM only permitting one rule for each combo of input and machine, this will not be compatible with other PFM mods that alter the 'Stephan's Lots of Crops' interactions with the seed maker. A compatibility patch will be required. Drop a post with a link to the other mod and I'll see about making a compatibility patch.
[/list]
